text: Could you make an explainer about why we hear echoes? I remember wondering about that as a kid, so it feels like a fun thing to explain. What I have in mind is a 10-second vertical video with a voice-over, and I'd like you to write the words yourself. Please keep the explanation easy for kids to understand. You can choose the look, since I don't have a particular visual style in mind.
